_izoh: Gemini TTS ovoz profillari. Mijoz persona'sidan (jins + yosh) yoki ssenariydagi voice.profile dan tanlanadi. 'voice' — Gemini ovoz katalogidagi id (GET /v1beta/voices). 'style' — gapirish yo'nalishi; {age}, {role}, {speakingStyle} persona'dan qo'yiladi. Yosh: child < 13, teen 13-17, young 18-29, adult 30-54, elder 55+. Katalogda 20 yoshdan kichik ovoz YO'Q — bola/o'smir uchun eng yosh (20-22) ovozlar + uslub. Keksa: katalogdagi 65 yoshli ovozlar; muqobil 'Grandparent' ovozlari: en-za-assistant-5 (ayol, 73), ar-eg-assistant-8 (erkak, 73), ja-jp-assistant-6 (ayol, 74), fr-ca-assistant-3 (ayol, 86).
readingRule: Read the text EXACTLY as written, word for word, in natural colloquial Uzbek (Latin script). Do not translate, add, skip, repeat or change any word. Uzbek pronunciation, no foreign accent.
